appDescription: An in-car assistant that keeps the business-car logbook from the dashboard odometer, notices sleeping passengers, and records designated-driver trips for the owner.

function.name: LOG_TRIP_PURPOSE
function.description: Record the purpose of the most recently finished trip in the business-car logbook.

purpose.description: Purpose of the trip: commuting, other business use, or personal use.

memo.description: A short note on the trip that goes into the remarks column of the logbook.

user_name.description: Name of the registered person who used the car on this trip.

function.name: SET_SLEEP_CARE
function.description: Turn the passenger sleep care feature on or off.

enabled.description: True to turn passenger sleep care on, false to turn it off.

function.name: START_DESIGNATED_DRIVER_MODE
function.description: Open the designated-driver mode screen, where the driver agrees before the trip record and owner notices start.

notify_family.description: Whether to notify the owner's registered contacts at departure and arrival.
